text:
maria: Quick idea
Propose a 2-week "stabilize" mini-wave: fix top 3 regressions + one low-risk enhancement behind a flag. Thoughts?
sohail: +1. Suggest list: embeddings p99 regression, streaming disconnects on bursts, and the rate-limit spike. Enhancement: prompt templating behind flag.
cassie: Telemetry confirms embeddings p99 spike affects 7 orgs, 2 enterprise with timeouts. Streaming disconnects happen in 1-2 minute burst windows; rate-limit tied to a proxy rule misroute.
alex: CS says one enterprise may pause feature rollout until embeddings stable. Embeddings work ~3 dev-days if it's a model-pin + small runtime tweak.
maria: Prioritization criteria: 1) customer severity 2) regression magnitude 3) rollout complexity 4) rollback cost. We'll score H/M/L and pick top 3.
emma: I can wireframe the prompt templating UI in 1 designer-day; its low risk and flaggable.
sam: I can add a model-pin toggle in ~2 business days if its config-only; cross-region routing +1 day.
maria: Decision: scope = 3 bugs + 1 flaggable enhancement. Owners: sohail (embeddings), cassie (streaming), rachel (rate-limit), emma+alex (templating). PRs by EOD Fri, canary mid-next-week, full rollout after 48h stable.
deploy-bot: Canary started for thread 1749009999-emb-fix on prod-1 at 2024-11-07T09:12:10Z.
cassie: I'll run health-checks every 10m during canary and have on-call rotation ready.
sam: Rollback quick commands for reference: `redwood runtime pin --unset model=embedding-v2` and `redwood feature-flag disable prompt_templating`.
maria: I'll notify the 2 affected enterprise contacts and update release notes. Post sprint board link here when created.
deploy-bot: Canary completed; 48h monitoring window started  no regressions detected so far. :white_check_mark:
